basic_details.job_title: Shri Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Principal, Lecturer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shri Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya in Dashashwamedh, Varanasi, is filling 9 regular teaching posts: Principal, Lecturer, Assistant Lecturer and Teacher. Most posts are in Sanskrit subjects (Darshan, Jyotish, Vyakaran, Sahitya and Puran), and two are in Modern Hindi. All posts are unreserved, and applications go by registered post within 21 days of the advertisement's publication. Counted from 12 October 2026, that is 2 November 2026, so there is little time left to send the form.

how_to_apply: Prepare a statement of your eligibility details.
Include your Aadhaar card, a passport-size photograph, your mobile number and your email ID.
Attach all mark sheets and certificates, each self-attested.
Get a bank draft of Rs. 1000/- payable to the Manager, Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya, Dashashwamedh, Varanasi-221001.
Make two copies of the complete application.

Send it by registered post so that it arrives within 21 days of the advertisement's publication. The advertisement is issued by the Manager (Prabandhak), Shri Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya, D. 17/58, Dashashwamedh, Varanasi-221001 (Uttar Pradesh).

Incomplete or faulty applications, and applications that arrive after the deadline, will not be accepted and will be rejected. For questions, call the college on 9936182893 or email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About Shri Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya
content_sections.text: Shri Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya is a Sanskrit college at D. 17/58, Dashashwamedh, Varanasi, established in 1944. Its letterhead describes it as a first-class, state-aided college of Uttar Pradesh, affiliated to Sampurnanand Sanskrit Vishwavidyalaya, Varanasi, and the UGC. The posts are sanctioned by the Uttar Pradesh Government, and qualifications follow the university's qualification ordinance.

content_sections.heading: Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya Assistant Lecturer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates for Principal must be at least 30 years old. The notice gives no age limit for the other posts. Mandatory: a postgraduate degree (Acharya), with at least second class, in any one subject of the 'Ka' category or an equivalent subject. Mandatory experience: 5 years of teaching postgraduate-level classes. Minimum age: 30 years. Preferred: a traditional degree and Vidyavaridhi. Mandatory: a postgraduate degree in Darshan or Jyotish, as applicable, with at least second class. Preferred: a traditional Acharya degree. Mandatory: a postgraduate degree in Vyakaran, Sahitya or Puran, as applicable, with at least second class. Preferred: a traditional Acharya degree. faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Lecturer posts are there?
faq.answer: There are 5 Assistant Lecturer posts: 2 in Vyakaran, 1 in Sahitya, 1 in Puran and 1 in Modern Hindi.

faq.question: Q2. Is any post reserved for SC, ST or OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that all posts are unreserved.

faq.question: Q3. How do I pay the application fee?
faq.answer: Pay Rs. 1000/- by a bank draft payable to the Manager, Shastrarth Mahavidyalaya, Dashashwamedh, Varanasi-221001, and send it with your application.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply online or by email?
faq.answer: No. Applications must be sent by registered post, in two copies.

faq.question: Q5. What experience does the Principal post need?
faq.answer: Five years of teaching postgraduate-level classes, along with a second-class Acharya postgraduate degree and a minimum age of 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is an Acharya degree compulsory for Lecturer and Assistant Lecturer?
faq.answer: No. A second-class postgraduate degree in the subject is the requirement. A traditional Acharya degree is only given preference for the Lecturer, and the Vyakaran, Sahitya and Puran Assistant Lecturer posts.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must go with the application?
faq.answer: Send your Aadhaar card, a passport-size photograph, your mobile number, your email ID and all self-attested mark sheets and certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Which university is the college affiliated to?
faq.answer: The college is affiliated to Sampurnanand Sanskrit Vishwavidyalaya, Varanasi. The qualifications for these posts follow the university's qualification ordinance.

faq.question: Q9. Where were the advertisements published?
faq.answer: The advertisement appeared in the Hindustan newspaper on 12 October 2026 and in the Aaj newspaper on 13 October 2026.
